title: Compatible-section module of a formal glueing datum
statement: Let $R,S$ be commutative rings, $\varphi:R\to S$ a ring map, $t\ge0$ an integer, $f_1,\ldots,f_t\in R$, and $\mathbf M=(M',(M_i)_i,(\alpha_i)_i,(\alpha_{ij})_{i,j})$ a formal glueing datum [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data]. Write $P_f$ for module localization, with map $p\mapsto p/1$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away], and $P\otimes_RS$ for base change [def-weil-module-base-change]. Define $H^0(\mathbf M)$ to be the $R$-submodule of $M'\times\prod_{i=1}^tM_i$ consisting of all $(m',(m_i)_i)$ such that $\alpha_i(m'/1)=m_i\otimes1$ for every $i$ and $\alpha_{ij}(m_i/1)=m_j/1$ for every $i,j$; $M'$ is regarded as an $R$-module through $\varphi$.
